Seamless rolled rings & races

Rings upset, pierced and rolled in one heat, then annealed in-house. Supplied as-forged, shot-blasted or proof-machined to your drawing.

How it's made

From bar to ring in one heat.

  1. Bar checkSpectro test and colour code
  2. CuttingCircular saw with auto loader
  3. HeatingInduction or oil-fired furnace
  4. Upset & piercePower press
  5. Ring rollingSame heat, to near-net size
  6. AnnealingBell furnace, logged cycle
  7. Shot blastingTumbler, 0.45 / 0.55 mm shot
  8. InspectionHardness, visual, MPI, PDI report
